name: Dokploy Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 open-source core for self-hosting application, Docker Compose and database deployments on your own servers, without a per-app or per-deployment software subscription.
watch_out: Provide and pay for VPS/bare-metal resources, storage, backups, domains and networking. Managed Dokploy Cloud is paid after a trial; enterprise features under proprietary/ use a separate paid source-available license. Only the open-source core is covered.
